newsitem.title: USA: PharmaPrint says sees meeting year goals.
newsitem.headline: PharmaPrint says sees meeting year goals.

text.p: PharmaPrint Inc said Monday it expects to stay on track to meet previously announced expectations of more than $14 million in cash during the current fiscal year ending March 31, 1997.

PharmaPrint said it had agreements with two European companies to develop pharmaceutical versions of three herbal medicines addressing current markets of $1.9 billion and said it expects to announce other agreements in the next several weeks.
The company said it expects cash from these and/or other agreements to begin contributing to financial results within 90 days. No dollar value for the agreements was disclosed.
